plan.title: bug(ingest): issue:ingest harvests a lean's Reject list, footnotes and arc record-keeping as plan items

narratives.Description: Ingest of an accepted lean takes every list line after the Bound-remedy heading as a plan item, so the Reject list, footnotes and arc record-keeping become items that need hand-written acceptance. Ingest of a plain issue makes a clause from every body sentence, background included, so each context sentence becomes another false-positive and disposition surface. This story keeps only the remedy limbs and the acceptance surface as items and clauses, stores Reject lines as must-not text, and keeps the rest as unscored background.
narratives.Overview:
1. The Bound-remedy slice ends at the next heading of level 2 or higher, or at a whole-line, non-list trailer label from a closed set (`Reject`, `Not proposed`, `Footnote`, `Footnotes`, `takes`, `Residual`, `Notes`, `Coordination`, with an optional parenthesised qualifier before the colon). `hashBoundRemedyBytes` calls that same slicer. relieves: P1
2. In the cited lean, list lines under a `Reject` or `Not proposed` heading or label go to `plan.narratives.Constraint` as must-not lines. Footnote and take lines go to neither `plan.items` nor clauses. relieves: P1
3. On a plain issue body that has at least one acceptance-shaped section (every heading `findAcHeading` or `SECTION_HEADING` matches, not only the first), plan items and clauses come from all of those sections plus every explicitly declared acceptance line anywhere in the body (`Done when`, `test:`, `acceptance:` lines, as `collectStatementSurface` reads them today). `plan.narratives.Overview` and the task statement passed to clause stamping hold only that selected surface; the rest of the body is stored as `plan.narratives.Background`, scanned with the existing untrusted-text scanner, and excluded from sentence coverage and from the `collectTaskStatementFromPlan` fall-through. A body without such a section ingests as today. relieves: P2
4. Fixtures: a #6189-shaped lean gives its 6 limbs as items and its Reject lines in `Constraint`; a colon-intro line, a limb ending in `:`, nested sub-bullets and a limb whose prose names `Reject:` all stay harvested; an issue with Summary plus Acceptance gives clauses only from Acceptance; sibling Acceptance and Test sections and an inline `Done when` line outside them all stay clauses; Overview holds only the selected surface, Background and Constraint text is scanned; an Expected-only body ingests as today; equal lean bodies keep equal harvest digests.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer ingesting an issue or an accepted lean, I want only the work to build to become plan items and clauses, so that I do not hand-write acceptance for Reject lists, footnotes, arc bookkeeping or background sentences.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Follow the accepted Prefer-A Bound on #6265 (comment 6857463007, synthesis 6857516008, verified-claims 6857512471). In packages/core/src/intake/markdown-scanners.ts, end the Bound-remedy slice at the next H2 or a closed non-list trailer label (Reject, Not proposed, Footnote(s), takes, Residual, Notes, Coordination, optional parenthesised qualifier) and have hashBoundRemedyBytes in packages/core/src/design-critique/pain-audit-follow-through-gate.ts call the same slicer. In packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts, route the lean's Reject and Not proposed list lines to plan.narratives.Constraint and keep footnote and take lines out of items and clauses. For a plain body with acceptance-shaped sections, harvest every such section plus declared acceptance lines, set Overview and the clause-stamp task statement to that surface, and store the rest as scanned plan.narratives.Background excluded from sentence coverage (packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/acceptance.ts) and the task-statement fall-through (packages/core/src/intake/clause-derivation.ts). Bodies without such a section ingest as today. Verify with the new fixture test file packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest-harvest-trailers.test.ts and the existing markdown-scanners, issue-ingest and pain-audit-follow-through-gate tests.

confessions: bug(ingest): issue:ingest harvests a lean's Reject list, footnotes and arc record-keeping as plan items

issueCommentThread.body:
A related case from a consumer project, same root (ingest takes text that is not acceptance as plan items and clauses):

- Ingest makes a clause from every sentence of the issue body, context and background included. One issue carried 35 clauses. A sibling issue dropped from 30 to 11 once its context moved from the body into a comment.
- Each extra clause is another place for a false positive (#6269, #6270) and another disposition at completion.

So the fix here should cover issue bodies as well as leans: take acceptance from the acceptance or goal section and treat the rest as narrative, not clauses. Until then, the workaround is to keep the issue body to goal plus acceptance and put context in a comment.

conflict_group: ingest-harvest-non-acceptance
Target-digest: sha256:bc0f7a685b738df4c8358cfedbc46decff7fc94eef6d17621f5df781e993754c
Spec-path: packages/core/src/intake/markdown-scanners.ts (extractBoundRemedyHarvest) + packages/core/src/intake/issue-ingest.ts (buildIssueVbrief) + packages/core/src/verify-ac/clauses.ts (statement surface)

## In plain English
Ingest turns too much text into work. From a lean it keeps reading past the remedy into the Reject list, footnotes and arc bookkeeping; from a plain issue it makes a clause out of every sentence, background included. Prefer-A: stop the remedy slice at the first label that is not a remedy limb, keep Reject lines as must-not text, and on plain issues take clauses only from the Acceptance, Expected or Goal section when one exists.

## Evidence (pin 1fa8ab9cc7b1aad651e6d65e4103f7820bde3d04)
- [extractBoundRemedyHarvest markdown-scanners.ts L223-236](https://github.com/deftai/directive/blob/1fa8ab9cc7b1aad651e6d65e4103f7820bde3d04/packages/core/src/intake/markdown-scanners.ts#L223-L236) slices with `sliceAcSection` (L340-350), which ends only at the next level-2-or-higher heading. The #6189 lean wrote `Reject:`, `Footnotes …:` and `takes:` as colon labels, so the slice ran to the end of the comment and `parseListItems` (L367) took every bullet: 34 items, 6 real.
- A label-terminated slicer already exists: `sliceColonLabelSection` / `isSameShapeColonLabelLine` (L286-306).
- `hashBoundRemedyBytes` (`packages/core/src/design-critique/pain-audit-follow-through-gate.ts:88-89, 211-237`) uses the same slice; it must move in lockstep.
- Plain body: `deriveAcceptanceClauses` (`packages/core/src/verify-ac/clauses.ts:579-618`) and `statementSentencesOnPlan` (`packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/acceptance.ts:353-398`) take every sentence of Overview, which holds the whole body; `SECTION_HEADING` (`clauses.ts:79-80`) knows `acceptance`, `done`, `test`, not `expected` or `goal`.
- Schema has `plan.narratives.Constraint` (`content/vbrief/schemas/xbrief-core-0.8.schema.json:117`), outside the sentence and declared-acceptance key lists.

## Draft remedy
1. Bound-remedy slice ends at the next level-2-or-higher heading or the next whole-line colon label (reuse `isSameShapeColonLabelLine`); `hashBoundRemedyBytes` uses the same slice.
2. In the cited lean, list lines under a `Reject` heading or label go to `plan.narratives.Constraint` as must-not lines; footnotes and arc record-keeping stay out of `plan.items` and clauses.
3. Plain issue body: when an `Acceptance`, `Expected` or `Goal` section exists, plan items and clauses come only from those sections, and the rest of the body is stored as a narrative outside the sentence-coverage keys. Without such a section, behaviour is unchanged.
4. Fixtures: a #6189-shaped lean gives 6 items and the Reject lines in `Constraint`; an issue with Summary plus Acceptance gives clauses only from Acceptance; a body with no such section ingests as today.

## Not proposed
No change to the completed-arc gate, the Spec-path token or story-quality rules. Completed briefs are not re-ingested.

Round 1, ceiling comment 6857039893, pin `1fa8ab9cc7b1aad651e6d65e4103f7820bde3d04`. Read `.deft-scratch/arc/6265-thread.md` through that ceiling (Prefer-A lean 6857039379; Stop 1 pains P1–P2 + invariant 6857039893) and pin-read `markdown-scanners.ts`, `issue-ingest.ts` (`buildIssueVbrief` / `extractPlanItems` / `ingestOne`), `clauses.ts`, `clause-derivation.ts`, `acceptance.ts`, `pain-audit-follow-through-gate.ts`, `completed-arc-record.ts`, `content/vbrief/schemas/xbrief-core-0.8.schema.json`, and the #6189 brief under `xbrief/completed/`.

## Verdict

Prefer-A correctly names the shared Bound-remedy over-slice (P1) and the whole-body clause scrape (P2), and reusing a label-aware terminator plus `plan.narratives.Constraint` matches inventory. It cannot bind as written: ending the remedy slice at any same-shape colon label can drop real limbs, which breaks the Stop 1 invariant. Expected/Goal as an acceptance source also needs a narrower cut before bind.

## F1 - blocks-the-design: Open colon-label terminator can drop real limbs

Evidence: Prefer-A draft remedy item 1 ends the Bound-remedy slice at the next whole-line colon label via `isSameShapeColonLabelLine` (`markdown-scanners.ts:286-291`, used at `:300` / `:325`). That helper accepts any `Label:` line that is not already a list item. `extractBoundRemedyHarvest` today only stops at the next same-or-higher heading (`:234` → `sliceAcSection` `:340-349`). List-item limbs that end with a colon, and limbs that name `Reject:` in prose, stay safe because `matchListItemLine` (`:393-416`) makes `isSameShapeColonLabelLine` return false. Nested sub-bullets before the first terminator also still parse. The failure mode is a non-list colon intro inside Bound-remedy (`Limb group A:` / `Cases:` / `Implementation notes:`) placed before the real bullets: the slice ends there and `parseListItems` returns fewer limbs than authored, including the empty-item case. That violates the invariant that real remedy limbs stay harvested, and Spec-path ingest already refuses an empty Bound-remedy list (`issue-ingest.ts:2427-2432`). Remedy: terminate on a closed trailer set that matches the #6189 shape (`Reject`, `Footnotes…`, `takes`), or otherwise require the terminator to be a known non-limb trailer; add fixtures for a colon-intro before limbs, a list limb ending in `:`, nested sub-bullets, and a limb whose prose contains `Reject:`.

## F2 - sharpens-framing: Expected/Goal is not a safe acceptance source

Evidence: draft remedy item 3 adds `Expected` and `Goal` beside `Acceptance` as the only plan-item and clause sources when present. `SECTION_HEADING` today knows `acceptance` / `done` / `test` only (`clauses.ts:79-80`); `deriveAcceptanceClauses` falls through to `collectStatementSurface` on the full task statement when `plan.items` are empty (`:579-606`). Ingest stamps clauses from `[title, harvestSource ?? overviewSource]` (`issue-ingest.ts:1704-1707`), so body-normative Overview is still the whole issue body. This issue’s own `## Expected` (thread snapshot) is design-goal prose, not observable acceptance; consumer `Goal` sections are the same class. Treating them as clause sources re-imports narrative as gate surface and undercuts P2. Remedy: drive the plain-body cut from `Acceptance` / existing Done-when / Test (and acceptance-shaped lines already detected by `looksLikeAcceptanceShaped`), and keep Expected/Goal as narrative unless lines pass that acceptance-shaped check; fixture an Expected-only body that must not mint design-goal clauses.

## F3 - sharpens-framing: Bound-remedy hash lockstep and in-flight discharge

Evidence: Prefer-A correctly requires `hashBoundRemedyBytes` to move with the harvest slice. That helper still reimplements an H2-only cut (`pain-audit-follow-through-gate.ts:88-89, 211-237`) and hashes list titles inside it, so Reject / Footnotes / takes titles are in today’s digest for a #6189-shaped lean. Digests are recomputed live on cited and successor bodies (`:293-303`), so deploying a tighter slicer does not desync equal bodies. It does change which lean edits move the digest: scrubbing trailer titles no longer changes harvest identity, so an in-flight `harvest-changed` / `newBindLeanAndAudit` recovery that planned to discharge by deleting Reject/footnote/takes lines under Bound-remedy would stay blocked until a limb-affecting lean lands. Remedy: state that lockstep means one shared slicer (reuse harvest titles rather than a second NEXT_H2 copy), that trailer-only lean edits stop counting as harvest change, and that in-flight recoveries need a limb edit (or an explicit transition note)—not Reject-list churn.

## F4 - footnote: Overview relocation vs Spec-path and statement keys

Evidence: Spec-path Overview is defined as the harvest remainder (`issue-ingest.ts:1590-1602`; `#4524` comments). Shortening `sourceText` shrinks Overview and is consistent with that rule; putting Reject lines into schema `Constraint` (`xbrief-core-0.8.schema.json:117`) keeps them out of `STATEMENT_SENTENCE_NARRATIVE_KEYS` (`acceptance.ts:337-346`). Body-normative “rest of body outside sentence-coverage keys” is underspecified: `collectTaskStatementFromPlan` still appends every remaining narrative after the known key list (`clause-derivation.ts:115-120`), so a Background dump can re-enter clause derivation on activate/promote. Story-quality pressure from junk `plan.items` falls once P1 is fixed; no Spec-path token change is required. Remedy: name the destination key(s) and exclude them from both sentence-coverage and `collectTaskStatementFromPlan` fall-through.

## F5 - footnote: Draft is slightly thicker than P1–P2 need

Evidence: limbs 1–2 plus lean fixtures relieve P1; a narrow Acceptance-section cut relieves P2. Expected/Goal (limb 3) is the extra blast radius called out in F2. Thin Fail-Closed: keep Bound-remedy as the closed trailer terminator, Reject→Constraint, Acceptance-section plain-body cut, and the #6189 / Acceptance / no-section fixtures; leave Expected/Goal shaping as leftover-pain or an implementation note.

metadata.issueBody:
## Summary

When an issue carries an accepted Prefer-A lean, `issue:ingest` takes every list line in the lean as a plan item, not only the limbs. For #6189 the brief got 34 items:

- items 1-6: the limbs (the real scope);
- items 7-15: the lean's Reject list;
- items 16-18: footnotes;
- items 19-34: arc record-keeping (critic disposals and the operator steer).

Only items 1-6 describe behaviour to build. The others needed hand-written acceptance text to pass story quality (`OBSERVABLE_TERMS`), and a Greptile P1 on the activation PR (#6245) came from that padding.

## Expected

Ingest of a lean takes the limbs as items. Reject lines become must-not constraints (a narrative or a separate field), and footnotes and arc record-keeping stay out of `plan.items`.

## Notes

The #6189 brief records the split in its `IngestNote` narrative.

Refs #6189.
